mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.username, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status, o.paid_at AS paidAt, o.shipped_at AS shippedAt, o.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS itemCount FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.status = #{status} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS salesCount, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS totalAmount FROM `order` o INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND DATE(o.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.created_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS totalAmount FROM `order` o INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND DATE(o.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.created_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY p.category_id, c.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT p.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.shop_name AS shopName, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS totalAmount FROM `order` o INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.id = p.merchant_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND DATE(o.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.created_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY p.merchant_id, m.shop_name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT
YEARWEEK(o.created_at, 1) DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') DATE(o.created_at)
AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS amount FROM `order` o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND DATE(o.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.created_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY
YEARWEEK(o.created_at, 1) DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') DATE(o.created_at)
ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT d.stat_date AS date, SUM(d.created_flag) AS createdCount, SUM(d.paid_flag) AS paidCount, SUM(d.completed_flag) AS completedCount FROM ( SELECT DATE(o.created_at) AS stat_date, 1 AS created_flag, 0 AS paid_flag, 0 AS completed_flag FROM `order` o WHERE 1 = 1 AND DATE(o.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.created_at) <= #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(o.paid_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS created_flag, 1 AS paid_flag, 0 AS completed_flag FROM `order` o WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(o.paid_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.paid_at) <= #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(o.completed_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS created_flag, 0 AS paid_flag, 1 AS completed_flag FROM `order` o WHERE o.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(o.completed_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(o.completed_at) <= #{endDate} ) d GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY d.stat_date ASC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY status
